sim.ctl.edgeDefault: The initial value is the edge of {game}.
sim.ctl.edgeFromSession: The initial value is the edge of the game you wagered on most in this session ({game}).
sim.hist.caption: The horizontal axis is the final balance (credits); the vertical axis is the number of people who ended with that balance. The leftmost bar holds the people who went bankrupt.
sim.hist.title: Distribution of final balances
sim.lead: {players} virtual players each start with {bankroll} credits under the same conditions. Change the conditions and see how the results spread.
sim.paths.caption: Each line is one person. The horizontal axis is rounds; the dotted line is the starting balance.
sim.paths.title: Balance paths of {n} people
sim.scaled: On this device the calculation was reduced, and it ran with {n} people (originally {requested}).
sim.setup: A round is a bet in which a win returns twice the amount wagered, and the chance of winning is lower than one half by the house edge. The default bet is {bet} credits, and a player stops as bankrupt when the balance falls below the default bet.
sim.slot.bankCaption: The horizontal axis is the final balance (credits); the vertical axis is the share of people who ended with that balance.
sim.slot.bankLead: Under each of the two variants, {players} people each started with {bankroll} credits and played {rounds} rounds at {bet} credits per round.
sim.slot.conclusion: The share of winning rounds differs: {hitA} against {hitB}. The variant that wins more often feels more generous, but its long-run loss relative to the amount wagered is {lossA} against {lossB}.
sim.slot.exact: The values below are not from a simulation; they were calculated by counting all {combos} stop combinations.
sim.slot.lead: Two mathematical variants were built for the slot. The screen, the effects and the betting steps are the same; only the reel strips and the paytables differ.
sim.slot.row.sigma: Standard deviation per round (relative to bet)
sim.slot.row.under: Wins smaller than the bet (celebrated, but a loss)
sim.slot.title: Same return rate, different feel
sim.stat.ahead: People ahead of their starting balance
sim.stat.perWagered: Net relative to the amount wagered
sim.sys.desc.dalembert: After a loss, raise the bet by one unit ({bet} credits); after a win, lower it by one unit.
sim.sys.desc.fibonacci: After a loss, bet one step up the Fibonacci sequence; after a win, drop two steps (unit {bet} credits).
sim.sys.desc.flat: Bet the same amount every round ({bet} credits).
sim.sys.desc.martingale: After a loss, double the bet; after a win, return to the starting amount ({bet} credits).
sim.top.body: The top {top} ({n} people) ended at {threshold} credits or more, with an average of {mean} credits. Results like these are the ones that get retold as stories. Under the same conditions, {bust} went bankrupt, and the median of everyone is {median} credits (start: {bankroll} credits).
sim.top.title: The stories you hear come from the top {top}
